narrative.intro: Harris has obligated $1.2B in FY2026 to date across 11 awards, with an average award size of $107M. Harris obligations are up 27.7% year over year. Harris obligations have risen steadily from $376M in FY21 to $1.2B in FY26, with a notable increase to $918M in FY25 before reaching the current-year total. Harris award activity so far this fiscal year is concentrated in relatively large awards given the $107M average, which influences the company-level total and the year-over-year growth rate. Harris award counts and award-size patterns matter because the current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date. Harris stakeholders should treat the FY26 figure as a snapshot of obligations to date rather than a finalized annual total.

sections.heading: How has Harris trended over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Harris obligations rose from $376M in FY21 to $1.2B in FY26. Harris saw a steady climb with $313M in FY22, $386M in FY23, $459M in FY24, and $918M in FY25. Harris year-over-year obligations are up 27.7% entering FY26, reflecting larger award sizes and higher total obligations so far.
